scheme: Deterministic internal-placeholder format: PH-<NNN>-<CAT3>-<BRD3>-<LEDGER>. 'PH-' is a fixed marker meaning INTERNAL PLACEHOLDER ONLY (never a manufacturer SKU). <NNN> = canonical catalog row number zero-padded to 3 digits. <CAT3> = first 3 ASCII alphanumerics of the category, uppercased. <BRD3> = first 3 ASCII alphanumerics of the brand, uppercased. <LEDGER> = the Pn sheet token extracted from the ledger field (P1..P8). Every component is derived solely from already-audited catalog fields; no model number is invented or implied. Codes are ASCII-only and at most 24 characters.

collision_check.method: Case-insensitive exact-string comparison: each proposed code was uppercased and tested for membership in the set of all 142 real SKUs uppercased; the 8 proposed codes were also checked pairwise for mutual distinctness. 8 codes x 142 real SKUs = 1136 comparisons plus 28 pairwise comparisons; zero matches.
